Terms and conditions

Last updated: 5 October 2026

Draft for a concept site. Please have it reviewed by a lawyer and fill in the [brackets] before using it on a live website.
OrderingPricesDeliveryScheduled ordersPaymentCancellations & refundsPromo codesAccountsReviewsLiabilityContact

These terms apply when you browse the Chick Chicken website or place an order with Chick Chicken, Shop 5, Gondal Plaza, F-10 Markaz, Islamabad. By placing an order you agree to them.

1. Placing an order

Your order is a request to buy. It is confirmed when the restaurant accepts it and the status changes to “Preparing”. We may decline an order, for example if an item is unavailable, your address is outside our delivery areas, or we can’t reach you on the number you gave.

2. Prices and availability

Prices are in Pakistani Rupees and are shown on the menu and in your cart before you order. Items, deals and timed offers (such as the Midnight Deal, 11 PM to 4 AM) depend on availability and may change. If a price on the website is clearly wrong, we will contact you before preparing your order.

Taxes: [state whether prices include sales tax].

3. Delivery and pick-up

  • We deliver to the areas listed on the website. The minimum order for delivery is the amount shown at checkout (currently Rs. 499).
  • Delivery times are estimates (usually within 45 minutes) and can be longer at busy times or in bad weather.
  • Please make sure someone is available at the address. If the rider can’t reach you, we may [cancel the order / charge for it].
  • Pick-up orders can be collected from the branch once marked “Ready for pickup”.

4. Scheduled orders

You can schedule an order for today or up to two days ahead. We start preparing it about 45 minutes before the chosen time. Scheduled times are a target, not a guarantee.

5. Payment

You can pay by cash or card machine on delivery or at pick-up, or online with JazzCash, Easypaisa, SadaPay or a debit/credit card. Online payments are processed by the payment provider; Chick Chicken never asks for or stores your card number, PIN or one-time password. Never share your PIN or OTP with anyone, including people claiming to be from Chick Chicken.

6. Cancellations and refunds

  • You can cancel an order on the website until the restaurant starts preparing it. After that, please call us.
  • We may cancel an order if an item is unavailable or we can’t deliver; we will tell you why.
  • If you paid online and the order is cancelled, we refund the full amount to the same payment method within [X] working days.
  • If something is wrong with your order, contact us within [X hours] with your order number. We may replace the item or refund it.

7. Promo codes and deals

Promo codes apply only as described, can’t be exchanged for cash and can’t be combined unless we say so. We may end a promo code at any time. Deals include only the items listed in the deal.

8. Your account

You sign in with your mobile number and a one-time code. Keep your phone secure and tell us if you think someone else is using your account. You can ask us to delete your account at any time from your profile.

9. Ratings and reviews

Only customers whose order was delivered or collected can review that order. Reviews must be honest and about your own experience, and must not include offensive content or other people’s personal details. We may hide reviews that break these rules and may reply publicly.

10. Food, allergies and liability

Our food may contain or come into contact with common allergens such as wheat, milk, eggs, soy and nuts. If you have an allergy, call us before ordering. Our responsibility for any order is limited to the amount you paid for it, except where the law says otherwise.

11. Contact and changes

Questions or complaints: call +92 337 7770555 or email syedzaeemahmeddwe@gmail.com. We may update these terms; the date at the top shows the latest version. These terms are governed by the laws of Pakistan.

Privacy Policy

Last updated: 5 October 2026

Draft for a concept site. Please have it reviewed by a lawyer and fill in the [brackets] before using it on a live website.

This policy explains what personal information Chick Chicken collects when you use this website, why, and the choices you have.

What we collect

  • Account details: your name, mobile number, and optionally your email, gender, date of birth and profile photo.
  • Order details: items, delivery address and area, directions for the rider, order time, scheduled time and payment method. For wallet payments we keep the wallet number you entered; we never collect card numbers, PINs or OTPs.
  • Location (only if you allow it): when you tap “Use Current Location”, your browser shares your position so we can estimate your distance from the branch.
  • Reviews: your rating, comment and first name.
  • Device storage: the site saves your cart, chosen menu view and similar preferences in your browser.

How we use it

  • To prepare, deliver and track your order, and to contact you about it.
  • To verify your number when you sign in.
  • To show your order history, saved addresses and favourites.
  • To send offers by WhatsApp or SMS, only if you [agree to receive them]. You can opt out at any time.
  • To understand which items are popular and improve our service.

Who we share it with

  • Our riders see your name, phone number and address for the order they deliver.
  • Payment providers (JazzCash, Easypaisa, SadaPay, card processors) receive what they need to process your payment.
  • SMS/WhatsApp providers to send your sign-in code and order updates.
  • Authorities, if the law requires it. We do not sell your personal information.

How long we keep it

We keep order records for [X years] for accounting, and account details until you delete your account. Reviews stay public until you ask us to remove them.

Your choices

  • View and edit your profile at any time.
  • Delete your account from My Profile → Request Account Deletion.
  • Ask for a copy of your data or a correction by contacting us.

Security

We use [HTTPS and access controls] to protect your information. No website is completely secure, so please keep your phone and sign-in codes private.

Children

This website is not intended for children under [13].

Contact

Privacy questions: syedzaeemahmeddwe@gmail.com or +92 337 7770555, Shop 5, Gondal Plaza, F-10 Markaz, Islamabad.
